environment: Linux headless Chromium; viewport emulation and CDP CPU throttling, not physical phones; car origin and world contents changed since v13/v15, so routes and actor states are not identical
method: 300 RAF intervals per configuration, 100 walking + 100 driving with turning + 100 shooting/pursuit. Same key patterns, sequential isolated runs. Compact observations select scalar fields before CDP serialization; historical baseline used complete serialized snapshots. Sparse positions sampled after odd steps so walking out-and-back peaks can be observed. States and durations differ; direct old/new performance deltas are not controlled.
observation: Public snapshot is computed unchanged; only scalar player/vehicle fields and render/cache counters are serialized through CDP. Same key patterns and 100 RAF samples per phase. Sparse positions sampled after odd steps instead of even steps to avoid observing only returns on the walking out-and-back route. Historical v13 measurements transferred full snapshots; direct performance deltas are not controlled.
